description: This file defines the ReportToDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manage report-to relationships between employees, including setting supervisor and subordinate employees by employee number and setting reporting methods by ID.

classes.name: ReportToDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ReportTo entity, providing methods to set supervisor/subordinate employees and reporting methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ReportTo entity instance.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee in the ReportTo entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setSubordinateEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the subordinate employee in the ReportTo entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setReportingMethodByReportingMethodId
methods.description: Sets the reporting method in the ReportTo entity based on reporting method ID.
